why: sessionId is null when the marketplace has never opened a session, and that is not the same as zero. Also the older `connectionId` spelling, which all three SDKs still accept.

source.constructed: a marketplace that has never opened a session, which a working dev server does not have, and the pre-rename `connectionId` field. The server sends `id` now; every SDK accepts both on purpose -- Java by @JsonAlias, Python and TypeScript by falling back -- and this is what keeps the old path covered once nothing sends it any more.
